mapper.insert: INSERT INTO merchant_callback_config (merchant_id, success_url, fail_url, notify_url, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{merchantId}, #{successUrl}, #{failUrl}, #{notifyUrl}, #{now}, #{now}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE success_url = VALUES(success_url), fail_url = VALUES(fail_url), notify_url = VALUES(notify_url), updated_at = VALUES(updated_at)
